scope: Fresh full v2 API outcome comparison between the current fork with opt-in engine fallback and the actual hosted API. All 100 frozen targets, one request/profile. Fork direct VN egress; provider routing and internal retries are not matched.

protocol.hostedInfrastructure: Provider controlled; region, proxies, resources and internal attempts unknown
protocol.pacingScope: Per-profile dispatch gate, including pre-request waits; metadata preflight calls are separate from capped scrape requests.

creditUsage.billingAttribution: Balance delta may include concurrent account activity. Logical requests do not bound provider internal attempts or exact billed credits.

limits: One live round is an outcome comparison, not stable per-site availability or a causal code, browser, proxy or regional experiment.
Provider refusal, account-level errors, target-site failures and missing markers remain in the original 100-target denominator.
Normalized body-marker retrieval does not establish CSS visibility, extraction F1, complete crawling or recurring refresh.
WAF labels come from the frozen publisher fixture; active commercial WAF rules were not independently verified.
Additional alternate-browser resources and provider-controlled infrastructure differ. These are not equal-cost or equal-resource deployments.
Earlier 42/100 fork versus 80/100 hosted results remain separately source-pinned; they are not relabeled as this measurement.

precedingActualComparison.scope: Different source, owner topology, navigation policy and live epoch. No causal code-gain claim.

implementationVerification.scope: Production implementation unchanged since those focused and CI checks. This turn repeats the live provider comparison, not the source test suite.

supplementaryMarkdownMetrics.scope: Same stored request payloads; conjunction of the frozen normalized HTML score and the existing supplementary Markdown marker. This is not extraction F1 or a replacement score.

hostedReportedRoutingTelemetry.scope: Response values preserved verbatim. They do not expose actual IPs, regions, provider attempts or causal reasons for success. The fork remained direct despite its legacy basic metadata label.

requestProxyPolicy.fork: No upstream proxy; direct VN egress verified in all owner containers.
requestProxyPolicy.hosted: Default provider-controlled routing. No proxy parameter override was sent; physical routing cannot be verified from API metadata.

auditOutputPathCorrection.scope: The first derived-summary audit stopped before writing because its output path still named the earlier receipt. The existing receipt was protected by an existence assertion. Only the new summary path was corrected; target requests were not rerun.
